Pork and fennel sausage meat rolled in buttery puff pastry with sesame seeds, baked golden and flaky, served hot with a sharp tomato relish. Mix 500g sausage mince with a grated onion, 1 tsp crushed fennel seeds, 30g breadcrumbs and pepper. Halve 2 puff pastry sheets, lay a log of filling along each strip and roll up, sealing with beaten egg. Cut each into 4, brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden and puffed. Serve hot with tomato relish.

Pretzels, peanuts and cereal squares baked in a Worcestershire, garlic and brown sugar butter until crunchy, tossed with chocolate drops once cool. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder and half a tsp smoked paprika. Toss with 150g mini pretzels, 150g roasted peanuts and 150g wheat cereal squares in a large tray. Bake at 140C for 40 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Cool completely, then toss through 100g chocolate drops. Tip into paper bags for the car.

Hot-smoked salmon flaked and folded through cream cheese with dill, lemon zest and capers, spread on rye crispbread and finished with a squeeze of lemon.
M: Salmon fillets spread with Dijon and topped with breadcrumbs, parsley and lemon zest, roasted at 220C for 10 minutes, with crushed potatoes and buttered green beans.

Chicken thighs grilled in a sticky soy, mirin, ginger and garlic glaze, sliced over steamed rice with a sesame cabbage salad and pickled ginger. Simmer 100ml soy sauce, 60ml mirin, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 crushed garlic cloves for 5 minutes until syrupy. Cook 300g jasmine rice. Grill or pan-fry 800g chicken thighs for 5 minutes a side, brushing with the glaze for the last few minutes until sticky. Toss shredded cabbage with rice vinegar and sesame oil. Slice the chicken over the rice with the salad, sesame seeds and pickled ginger.
W: Mixed berries with sugar and lemon under an oat and butter crumble, baked at 180C for 35 minutes. Toss 500g mixed berries with 50g sugar and a squeeze of lemon and spread in a dish. Rub 100g butter into 100g oats, 100g flour and 80g sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until bubbling and serve with vanilla ice cream.

Strong espresso stirred into steamed milk with melted dark chocolate, topped with whipped cream and shaved chocolate, served in big mugs. Brew 4 strong espresso shots, or 250ml very strong coffee. Warm 800ml milk with 100g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tbsp sugar, whisking until melted and frothy, without boiling. Divide the coffee between four big mugs and pour over the chocolate milk. Top each with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and shave a little chocolate over the top.
